name: gemini-media
description: Generate images (Nano Banana), video (Veo, Gemini Omni), speech (Gemini TTS) and music (Lyria) with Google's generative media models, with cost estimates and spend budgets.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Optional. Key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey, stored in your system keychain. Leave empty to use GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY from your environment, the key saved by `gemini-media-mcp configure --api-key-stdin`, or Vertex AI (GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT + gcloud credentials).

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where generated images, videos and audio are saved.

daily_budget_usd.title: Daily budget (USD)
daily_budget_usd.description: Optional. Refuse new generations once today's estimated spend reaches this amount. Leave empty to keep the budget from your config file (none by default).
